cards.ex: I always hit the snooze button at least twice before actually getting up.
cards.exUz: Men har doim turishdan oldin kamida ikki marta signalni kechiktiraman.
cards.uzDef: Budilnikni o'chirib, yana biroz uxlash uchun signalni kechiktirish.

cards.ex: We need to get going if we want to be on time for the meeting.
cards.exUz: Agar yig'ilishga vaqtida borishni istasak, ketishga tayyorlanishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror joyga ketishga tayyorlanish yoki harakatni boshlash.

cards.ex: Let's grab a bite after work. I'm starving.
cards.exUz: Ishdan keyin tamaddi qilaylik. Men juda ochman.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson ovqatlanish, masalan, snack yoki yengil taom yemoq.

cards.ex: I like to wind down by reading a book before bed.
cards.exUz: Men yotishdan oldin kitob o'qib dam olishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Kun oxirida tinchlanish va dam olish, stressni kamaytirish.

cards.ex: I need to sort out my emails before starting any new tasks.
cards.exUz: Yangi vazifalarni boshlashdan oldin elektron pochtalarimni tartibga solishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish yoki narsalarni to'g'ri joylashtirish.

cards.ex: I never seem to get around to cleaning my room.
cards.exUz: Men hech qachon xonamni tozalashga vaqt topolmayman.
cards.uzDef: Oxir-oqibat biror narsani qilishga vaqt ajratish.

cards.ex: I always try to make time for exercise, even when I'm busy.
cards.exUz: Men har doim mashg'ul bo'lsam ham, mashq qilishga vaqt ajratishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa uchun vaqt ajratish yoki vaqt topish.

cards.ex: I was so tired this morning I did everything on autopilot.
cards.exUz: Men bugun ertalab juda charchagan edim, hamma narsani avtomatik tarzda qildim.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday fikr yoki e'tibor bermasdan avtomatik tarzda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: My grandfather is a creature of habit; he always eats the same breakfast.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom odat quli; u har doim bir xil nonushta qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Har doim bir xil narsalarni qilishni afzal ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: I try to hit the gym three times a week.
cards.exUz: Men haftada uch marta sport zaliga borishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Sport zalida mashq qilish uchun bormoq.

cards.ex: I need to catch up on the news; I haven't watched it all week.
cards.exUz: Men yangiliklarni bilib olishim kerak; men uni butun hafta davomida tomosha qilmadim.
cards.uzDef: O'tkazib yuborilgan narsalarni bajarish yoki bilib olish.

cards.ex: I have to run some errands this afternoon.
cards.exUz: Men bugun tushdan keyin bir nechta xarid qilishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kichik vazifalarni bajarish, masalan, do'konga borish yoki to'lovlarni to'lash.

cards.ex: It's hard to stick to a diet when you're surrounded by delicious food.
cards.exUz: Mazali ovqatlar bilan o'ralganingizda dietaga rioya qilish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Biror qoidaga, rejaga yoki odatga sodiq qolish.

cards.ex: It's important to unplug and relax sometimes.
cards.exUz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan uzilib, dam olish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Elektron qurilmalardan va internetdan uzoqlashish, dam olish.

cards.ex: I'm trying to make a habit of drinking more water.
cards.exUz: Men ko'proq suv ichishni odat qilishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani doimiy ravishda qilishni odat qilish.

cards.ex: I had to burn the midnight oil to finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: Men loyihani vaqtida tugatish uchun kechgacha ishlashimga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Kechgacha yoki tun yarimgacha qattiq ishlash yoki o'qish.

cards.ex: Sometimes I get tired of the daily grind.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan men kundalik mashaqqatdan charchayman.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik rutin va ishning zerikarli va qiyin qismi.

cards.ex: I'm tired, let's call it a day and go home.
cards.exUz: Men charchadim, keling, yetar deb uyga ketaylik.
cards.uzDef: Ishni tugatish yoki to'xtatish va dam olishga o'tish.

cards.ex: I'm definitely not a morning person; I need coffee to function.
cards.exUz: Men aniq ertalabki odam emasman; ishlashim uchun menga kofe kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ertalab tetik va faol bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: Eating healthy will benefit you in the long run.
cards.exUz: Sog'lom ovqatlanish uzoq muddatda sizga foyda keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, ko'p vaqt o'tgach.

cards.ex: You should take a break every hour to avoid getting burned out.
cards.exUz: Charchab qolmaslik uchun har soatda tanaffus qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan yoki faoliyatdan vaqtinchalik to'xtab, dam olish.

cards.ex: First thing in the morning, I check my emails.
cards.exUz: Ertalab birinchi navbatda, elektron pochtalarimni tekshiraman.
cards.uzDef: Ertalab yoki biror ishni boshlashda eng birinchi qiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: I exercise on a regular basis to stay healthy.
cards.exUz: Men sog'lom bo'lish uchun doimiy ravishda mashq qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Tez-tez yoki muntazam ravishda.

cards.ex: It takes time to get into the habit of waking up early.
cards.exUz: Ertalab erta turish odatiga kirish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani muntazam ravishda qilishni boshlash.

cards.ex: I'm trying to quit smoking, but old habits die hard.
cards.exUz: Men chekishni tashlashga harakat qilyapman, lekin eski odatlar qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Eski odatlarni tashlash juda qiyin.

cards.ex: I like to go out for dinner once in a while.
cards.exUz: Men vaqti-vaqti bilan kechki ovqatga chiqishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Ba'zida, lekin tez-tez emas.

cards.ex: I try not to stay up too late on weeknights.
cards.exUz: Men ish kunlari kechgacha uxlamaslikka harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy vaqtdan kechgacha uxlashdan qochish.

cards.ex: I'm a night owl; I do my best work late at night.
cards.exUz: Men tungi boyo'g'liman; men eng yaxshi ishimni kechasi qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Kechasi faol va tetik bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: I love to sleep in on weekends.
cards.exUz: Men dam olish kunlari ertalab uxlashni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy vaqtdan keyinroqgacha uxlash.

cards.ex: It's important to get into a routine to stay productive.
cards.exUz: Unumdor bo'lish uchun rutinaga kirish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Muntazam ravishda bir xil narsalarni qilishni boshlash.
